content: Dev Chatterjee called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to discuss his policy renewal. He confirmed the $1,250 premium with the 5% loyalty discount was acceptable and inquired about policy continuity, which Neha assured would be seamless with no coverage gap. Dev requested a secure credit card payment link, which Neha sent via email and SMS. Dev confirmed no further assistance was needed.

action_items: Send secure credit card payment link via email and SMS
Receive confirmation receipt and updated policy document
